## sPTB and Cell Proportions

Here we are performing several models to evaluate the association between spontaneous preterm birth (sPTB) and placental cell proportions in the CANDLE and PATHWAYS GAPPS cohorts (N=635). We are modelling this with three methods: Composition Model, Bootstrapped Composition Model, and Beta Regressions. 

### Upload Data and Load Packages
```{r data and packages}
#Load Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(compositions)
library(robCompositions)
library(data.table)
library(parallel)
library(betareg)
library(foreach)
library(marginaleffects)

#Load Data
load("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/DeconvolutionData/ImputedCellProportions_withCollapse_CANDLEGAPPS_N635_sPTB_122325.RData")
load("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/CovariateData/FilteredCovariates_CANDLEGAPPS_sPTB_122325.RData")
percent_detected <-read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/CellTypes_PercentDetected_AfterCollapse_N635_sPTB_CANDLEGAPPS_122325.csv")
load("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/DeconvolutionData/composition_order_aftercollapse_N635_sPTB_122325.RData")
```

### Prepare Data and Check Covariates
```{r prep data and check covariates}
# add cell type data to covariate data.
data = ciber_cells_impute_res %>%  
  inner_join(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars)
#Check Data types
summary(data)

```

### sPTB and Cell Proportions- Composition Models
These models are evaluating the association between sPTB and Cell Proportions (relative proportion), but do not give p-values for individual cell types.

```{r sPTB and cell prop}
# reduce our cell_types variable to only include retained cell types
cell_types <- colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res)[colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res) != "pathways_id"]

# acomp is relative composition method, now all rows should sum to 1
outcome <- compositions::acomp(ciber_cells_impute_res[,cell_types])
rowSums(outcome)

# ilr:() is the Isometric log ratio transformation
comp_mod <- lm(ilr(outcome) ~ Age + BMI + EducationCollapsed  + RaceCollapsed + Ethnicity + FetalSex + Parity + LaborStatus + DeliveryMethod + SmokingComposite + Alcohol + Batch + PTB, data=data)

# extract coefficients in inverse-ILR scale
compositions::ilrInv(coef(comp_mod), orig=outcome)

# extract pvalue associated with preterm birth
anova(comp_mod)['PTB',6] ## Significant association!

```

### sPTB and Cell Proportions- Bootstrapping
These models evaluate sPTB and cell proprotions and have p-values for each individual cell type.
```{r sPTB and cell prop - bootstrapping}

expected_names <- c(cell_types, "Fstat") 
nboot = 1000 # number of bootstrap repetitions
no_cores = detectCores() - 1 # number of computer cores to use for parallel loop 
cl <- makeCluster(no_cores) # create parallel backend
# Make results reproducible across runs
clusterSetRNGStream(cl, 123)

clusterEvalQ(cl, {
  library(compositions)
  library(data.table)
  library(parallel)
})

clusterExport(cl, varlist = c("nboot", "data", "cell_types"))

tmp <- parLapplyLB(cl, 1:nboot, function(b) {
  
  # Sample with replacement
  rep_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(data)), size = nrow(data), replace = TRUE)
  boot_data <- data[rep_idx, ]
  
  # Compositional outcome for bootstrap sample
  outcome_b <- acomp(boot_data[, cell_types])
  
  # Fit model
  comp_mod_b <- lm(ilr(outcome_b) ~ Age + BMI + Education + Race + Ethnicity + 
                     FetalSex + Parity + LaborStatus + DeliveryMethod + SmokingComposite + Alcohol + Batch + PTB, data = boot_data)
  
  # Create PTB=No and PTB=Yes datasets
  new_no  <- boot_data; new_no$PTB  <- factor("No",  levels = levels(boot_data$PTB))
  new_yes <- boot_data; new_yes$PTB <- factor("Yes", levels = levels(boot_data$PTB))
  
  # Predict in ILR space
  pred_ilr_no  <- predict(comp_mod_b, newdata = new_no)
  pred_ilr_yes <- predict(comp_mod_b, newdata = new_yes)
  
  # Back-transform row-by-row into composition space- Updating this code to be more precise for bootstrapping
  basis <- ilrBase(outcome_b)
  
  #comp_no  <- t(apply(pred_ilr_no,  1, ilrInv, orig = outcome_b))
  #comp_yes <- t(apply(pred_ilr_yes, 1, ilrInv, orig = outcome_b))
  
  comp_no  <- t(apply(pred_ilr_no,  1, ilrInv, V = basis))
comp_yes <- t(apply(pred_ilr_yes, 1, ilrInv, V = basis))

colnames(comp_no)  <- cell_types
colnames(comp_yes) <- cell_types
  
  # Average across subjects → marginal predicted compositions
  dt_no  <- as.data.table(as.list(colMeans(comp_no)))
  dt_yes <- as.data.table(as.list(colMeans(comp_yes)))
  
  list(PTB_No = dt_no, PTB_Yes = dt_yes)
})

stopCluster(cl)

# Combine into data.tables
boot_no  <- rbindlist(lapply(tmp, function(x) x$PTB_No))
boot_yes <- rbindlist(lapply(tmp, function(x) x$PTB_Yes))

# Get column names (cell types)
cell_types_boot <- colnames(boot_no)

# Point estimates (means)
mean_no  <- colMeans(boot_no)
mean_yes <- colMeans(boot_yes)

estimates <- data.frame(
  CellType = cell_types_boot,
  PTB_No = mean_no,
  PTB_Yes = mean_yes,
  row.names = NULL
)

#Calculate percent difference in mean cell composition by PTB Status: Positive percent= higher in PTB
estimates$percent_diff <- 100 * (estimates$PTB_Yes - estimates$PTB_No) / estimates$PTB_No
#Display Composition as Percentages
estimates$PTB_No_Percent <- estimates$PTB_No * 100
estimates$PTB_Yes_Percent <- estimates$PTB_Yes * 100

# Confidence intervals
ci_no  <- apply(boot_no, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
ci_yes <- apply(boot_yes, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

# Format into separate dataframe
ci_df <- data.frame(
  CellType = cell_types,
  CI_No_Low = ci_no[1, ],
  CI_No_High = ci_no[2, ],
  CI_Yes_Low = ci_yes[1, ],
  CI_Yes_High = ci_yes[2, ],
  row.names = NULL
)

ci_diff <- apply(boot_yes - boot_no, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

sig_flags <- (ci_diff[1, ] > 0 & ci_diff[2, ] > 0) | (ci_diff[1, ] < 0 & ci_diff[2, ] < 0)

significance_df <- data.frame(
  CellType = colnames(boot_no),
  Diff_Low = ci_diff[1, ],
  Diff_High = ci_diff[2, ],
  Significant = ifelse(sig_flags, "yes", "no")
)
#Combine all REsults into one summary table

BootstrapSummary <- cbind(estimates, ci_df, significance_df)
BootstrapSummary <- BootstrapSummary %>%
  dplyr::select(-CellType, -PTB_No, -PTB_Yes)

BootstrapSummary$PTB_No_Percent <- format(BootstrapSummary$PTB_No_Percent, scientific = FALSE)
BootstrapSummary$PTB_Yes_Percent <- format(BootstrapSummary$PTB_Yes_Percent, scientific = FALSE)
BootstrapSummary$CellType <-rownames(BootstrapSummary)

BootstrapSummary$RelativeComparison <- 
    (as.numeric(BootstrapSummary$PTB_Yes_Percent) / 100) /
    (as.numeric(BootstrapSummary$PTB_No_Percent) / 100)

#Add confidence intervals
ci_ratio <- apply(boot_yes / boot_no, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

# Add these to your BootstrapSummary
BootstrapSummary$Ratio_CI_Low <- ci_ratio[1, ]
BootstrapSummary$Ratio_CI_High <- ci_ratio[2, ]

#We also want to include an absolute summary- calculating that here
BootstrapSummary$AbsoluteDiff <- (as.numeric(BootstrapSummary$PTB_Yes_Percent) - 
                                  as.numeric(BootstrapSummary$PTB_No_Percent))

BootstrapSummary$Abs_CI_Low  <- ci_diff[1, ] * 100
BootstrapSummary$Abs_CI_High <- ci_diff[2, ] * 100

#write_csv(BootstrapSummary, "/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/sPTB/sPTB_CellProportions_BootstrapResults_N635_020926.csv")
```

### Beta-Regression
Here we model each cell type individually not accounting for the composition overall.
```{r beta regression}
library(betareg)
library(broom)
library(dplyr)
library(foreach)

betareg_sPTB <- foreach(i = cell_types, .combine = "rbind") %do% {
  result <- tryCatch({
    formula_i <- as.formula(
      paste0(i,  "~ PTB + Age + BMI + EducationCollapsed + RaceCollapsed + Ethnicity + FetalSex + Parity + LaborStatus + DeliveryMethod + SmokingComposite + Alcohol + Batch")
    )
    
    model <- betareg(formula_i, data = data)
    
    # Get effect for PTBYes
    tidy_model <- broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>% 
      filter(term == "PTBYes") %>%
      mutate(
        estimate = exp(estimate),
        conf.low = exp(conf.low),
        conf.high = exp(conf.high),
        estimate_with_ci = paste0(round(estimate, 3), " [", round(conf.low, 3), " to ", round(conf.high, 3), "]"),
        significant = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "yes", "no"),
        cell_type = i
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(cell_type, term, estimate, std.error, p.value, conf.low, conf.high, estimate_with_ci, significant)
    
    # Get expected marginal means for PTB = Yes/No
    preds <- data %>%
      dplyr::select(PTB, Age, BMI, EducationCollapsed, RaceCollapsed, Ethnicity, FetalSex, Parity, LaborStatus, DeliveryMethod, SmokingComposite, Alcohol, Batch) %>%
      mutate(PTB = factor(PTB, levels = c("No", "Yes")))  # ensure proper level order
    
    preds$fit <- predict(model, newdata = preds, type = "response")
    
    ptb_means <- preds %>%
      group_by(PTB) %>%
      summarise(fitted = mean(fit)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = PTB, values_from = fitted, names_prefix = "PTB_") %>%
      mutate(cell_type = i)
    
    # Join both effects
    left_join(tidy_model, ptb_means, by = "cell_type")

  }, error = function(e) {
  warning(paste("Error for cell type:", i, "->", e$message))
    data.frame(
      cell_type = i,
      term = "PTBYes",
      estimate = NA,
      std.error = NA,
      p.value = NA,
      conf.low = NA,
      conf.high = NA,
      estimate_with_ci = "Error",
      significant = "Error",
      PTB_No = NA,
      PTB_Yes = NA
    )
  })
  
  return(result)
}

#Marginal Effects code
# list of the cell types where the beta regression did not fail
cell_types2 = betareg_sPTB %>% filter(estimate !="Error") %>% pull(cell_type)

ame_df <- foreach(i = cell_types2, .combine = "rbind") %do% {

  formula_i <- as.formula(
    paste0(i,  "~ PTB + Age + BMI + EducationCollapsed + RaceCollapsed + Ethnicity + FetalSex + Parity + LaborStatus + DeliveryMethod + SmokingComposite + Alcohol + Batch")
    )
  
  model <- betareg(formula_i, data = data)
  # avg_slopes used for 1 unit increase in contin exposure. avg_comparisons used for binary exposure variable like PTB
  avg_comparisons(
    model,
    variables = "PTB",
    newdata = data,
    type = "response"
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0("ame_", .x)) %>%
    mutate(cell_type = i)
}

composition_order_underscore <-gsub(" ", "_", composition_order)

# SCALE BY 100 HERE: transforms proportion (0.01) to percentage points (1.0)
ame_df <- ame_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
      ame_estimate_percent = ame_estimate * 100,
      ame_conf.low_percent = ame_conf.low * 100,
      ame_conf.high_percent = ame_conf.high * 100
    )

betareg_sPTB <- betareg_sPTB %>%
  left_join(ame_df)%>%
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_types, levels = composition_order_underscore)) %>%
  arrange(cell_type) %>%
  left_join(percent_detected, by = "cell_type")

#write_csv(betareg_sPTB, "/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/sPTB/sPTB_CellProportions_BetaRegressionResults_N635_020926.csv")
```

### Compare across Regression Types
```{r compare}
#Pull Sig Cell Types
Sig_Boot <- BootstrapSummary %>%
  dplyr::filter(Significant=="yes") %>%
  dplyr::select(CellType, AbsoluteDiff, Abs_CI_Low, Abs_CI_High)
Sig_Boot$RegressionType <- c("Bootstrap Composition")
colnames(Sig_Boot) <- c("CellType", "Estimate", "CI_Low", "CI_High", "RegressionType")

Sig_Beta <- betareg_sPTB %>%
  dplyr::filter(significant=="yes") %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, ame_estimate_percent, ame_conf.low_percent, ame_conf.high_percent)
Sig_Beta$RegressionType <- c("Beta Regression")
colnames(Sig_Beta) <- c("CellType", "Estimate", "CI_Low", "CI_High", "RegressionType")

# Combine
CombinedResults <- rbind(Sig_Boot, Sig_Beta)

#Fix Formatting of Cell Types
CombinedResults$CellType <- gsub("_", " ", CombinedResults$CellType)
CombinedResults$CellType <- str_to_title(CombinedResults$CellType)

#Fix Estimate Data Class
class(CombinedResults$Estimate)
CombinedResults$Estimate <- as.numeric(CombinedResults$Estimate)
class(CombinedResults$Estimate)

# Plot for easy visualization
ggplot(CombinedResults, aes(x=RegressionType, y=CellType, fill=Estimate)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=4) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#0080A2",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#EC7625",
    midpoint = 0  
  ) + 
  ggtitle("sPTB- N=635")

rownames(CombinedResults) <- NULL

#Save Combined Results
#write.csv(CombinedResults, "/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/sPTB/sPTB_N635_CombinedResults_020926.csv")
```
